questions.prompt: Which hook exposes a Server Action's return value and pending state?
questions.explanation: useActionState wraps an action and returns [state, formAction, isPending]; the action gains a prevState first argument. It comes from react.

questions.prompt: useActionState was previously named ____ (and imported from react-dom). Type the old hook name.
questions.explanation: useActionState is the current name; it was previously useFormState, imported from react-dom.

questions.prompt: Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

options.text: useFormStatus must be used in a child rendered inside the <form>
useOptimistic shows provisional UI before the server confirms
These hooks remove the need for server-side validation

questions.explanation: useFormStatus (react-dom) reads the parent form and must be in a child; useOptimistic shows provisional UI. Server-side validation is still required.

questions.prompt: Match each hook to its job and module.

pairs.right: First arg the action receives via useActionState

questions.explanation: useActionState and useOptimistic come from react; useFormStatus from react-dom; useActionState passes prevState to the action.

items.text: useOptimistic shows the incremented count immediately
The Server Action persists the like
Revalidation replaces the optimistic count with the confirmed one

questions.explanation: The optimistic value shows at once; the action persists the change; revalidation reconciles the UI with the real value.
